scientific_question: Do visual-stream rank, recurrent-memory-stream rank, and their interaction change cueing behavior, spatial representation, and causal routing dependence when carrier shape, parameter count, active-item count, and training budget are fixed?

hypothesis.simple_stream_count: More differentiable streams increase attention-related effects.
hypothesis.coherent_actionable_percept: Additional memory streams help most when they remain correctly bound to distinct visual streams, producing a positive visual-by-memory interaction and a reversible cost of rank-preserving visual-memory misbinding.

fixed_scientific_contract.paired_initialization: Within a routing family and seed, reset all training RNGs before construction and require an identical hash over every named trainable tensor in all four cells.
fixed_scientific_contract.paired_environment_rng: Within a seed, all four cells use the same environment RNG seed and must reproduce the registered trial-metadata trace hash.

required_checks: all four cells start from the same named-trainable-tensor SHA-256
visual and memory projector ranks equal the requested levels
projector buffers are fixed, finite, idempotent, and gradient-transparent
carrier shape is 100 tokens and actor/critic readout is 12800 in every cell
trainable parameter count is exactly 8682948 in every cell
environment RNG trace matches the registered seed-0 trace
checkpoint schema binds model_factory, effective stream levels, config, design, source, and launcher hashes
metrics are finite and contiguous for iterations 0 through 49
log has no traceback and the trainer writes the final canary checkpoint

required_completion: exactly 20000 contiguous finite metric rows for iterations 0 through 19999
schema-3 terminal final and latest checkpoints with finite equal required state
exact task, carrier, feedback, cell, d_mem, decay, fresh seed, and effective-stream contract
exact producer, config, design, preflight, and launcher SHA-256 provenance
clean final-save log and no traceback
remote and local bytes and SHA-256 match before atomic promotion
held-out behavior and mechanism evaluation passes artifact and semantic validation

environment_rng_trace.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON for 32 sequential VDA4 reset trial-metadata records after numpy.random.seed(seed)

calibration.selection_rule: Choose the smallest magnitude with natural invalid response rate in [0.50, 0.70]. If none exists, mark the primary causal estimand non-informative for that checkpoint.

intervention.magnitude: checkpoint-specific value frozen by the disjoint calibration bank

binding.constraint: The intervention preserves stream count, tensor rank, state values, parameters, and trial bank; only visual-memory spatial correspondence changes.

admission_gates.terminal_gate: Every production completion requirement must pass before scientific evaluation.

behavioral_competence.failure_disposition: Retain and report the terminal checkpoint, but mark attention-behavior estimands non-informative; never substitute training accuracy.

primary_causal_probe.failure_disposition: Report saturation or floor failure and do not interpret a null intervention contrast.

attention_integrity.failure_disposition: Reject attention localization and intervention artifacts.

behavior: valid-minus-invalid dprime with criterion reported separately
representation: cue-region routing mass during frames 2 through 4
true-change-region routing mass during frames 5 through 6
true-change-minus-cue-region reorienting contrast on forced-invalid trials
causal_use: natural-minus-disable invalid dprime and response rate
true-change suppress-to-boost dprime and response-rate rescue
spatial specificity versus cued-wrong and neutral-control targets

factorial_contrasts.notation: Y_V_M is one admitted held-out estimand for the cell with effective visual rank V and memory rank M.
factorial_contrasts.unit: independently trained seed, paired across all four cells
factorial_contrasts.aggregation: Report all seedwise contrasts, directional agreement, median, range, and sample standard deviation. With three seeds, do not report a population scaling law.

interpretation_rules.simple_stream_count_support: A positive registered stream contrast must agree directionally across all three seeds and across at least one behavioral, one representational, and one causal-use estimand without competence or saturation failures.
interpretation_rules.visual_bottleneck: Visual main effect is directionally consistent while memory main effect and interaction are not.
interpretation_rules.memory_bottleneck: Memory main effect is directionally consistent while visual main effect and interaction are not.
interpretation_rules.independent_capacity: Visual and memory main effects are directionally consistent while the interaction and binding intervention are negligible.
interpretation_rules.coherent_actionable_percept_support: The visual-by-memory interaction is directionally consistent and rank-preserving cyclic misbinding selectively impairs localization, decoding, and causal rescue, with restoration recovering them.
interpretation_rules.not_supported: Discordant seed directions, effects confined to training metrics, effects removed by dprime/criterion decomposition, or cells failing competence/non-saturation gates do not support the corresponding hypothesis.

evidence_boundaries: Engineering canaries, training accuracy, curriculum theta, and periodic checkpoints are never attention evidence.
Three training seeds support directional and descriptive-dispersion statements only, not population inference.
A crossattn1 result is routing-family-specific until the full affine_ew factorial is independently replicated.
Attention-mass differences are correlational unless accompanied by the registered causal intervention.
The fixed-rank projection operationalizes differentiable streams; it is not identical to adding biological neurons or independent cognitive modules.
No result licenses biological equivalence or a human/primate capacity claim.

next_stage_gate.affine_replication: After all 12 crossattn1 cells are terminal and evaluated, repeat the same matrix for affine_ew before any routing-family-independent statement.
next_stage_gate.population_extension: Add seeds 3 and 4 only under a separately frozen extension manifest; five seeds are the minimum target for an inferential claim.
